assay: bulk RNA-seq (polyA, NovaSeq 2x150), gastrocnemius muscle, 28-week-old female mice (S4.17.p1, S4.18.p1, S4.1.p2)
sample_inclusion: WT and SPAG7 KO gastrocnemius; Fig 3K legend says n=7; two samples removed for a batch effect and a label mismatch (S4.19.p1); GEO deposits 9 samples (5 WT, 4 KO)
primary_estimand: genotype effect (SPAG7 KO vs WT) on sedentary gastrocnemius transcriptome; no exercise intervention in the sequenced samples. Exercise appears only as a phenotype readout (treadmill endurance test, S2.3.p1, S4.12.p1) and no exercised animals were sequenced
planned_contrasts: SPAG7 KO vs WT gastrocnemius (S2.3.p2; paper: 1,848 up / 2,291 down = 4,139 DEGs)
normalization: Salmon -> tximport gene-level counts rounded to integers (S4.19.p1; GEO data_processing)
paper_method: DESeq2 v1.34.0 (~ genotype implied); apeglm shrinkage for GSEA; clusterProfiler ORA/GSEA (S4.19.p1)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S2.3.p2 says 'significantly' without a stated rule; S4.19.p1 states no cutoff
